Overcast has been in existence for 10 years and there’s probably not been a day in those 10 years that I haven’t used it. 

I listen to a lot of podcasts and one of the best features of the app is Smart Speed. This intelligently cuts out gaps in speech in a way that nobody would notice…unless you listen to a podcast WITHOUT it and you discover someone you like has…..long……pauses…..in……their…..speech. I’ve listened to so many podcasts that this has “saved me” weeks of “not listening to pauses”. 

The app by default also will “un-pause” a podcast with a slight repeat of the last section of speech (maybe 10 seconds) - so you “return to your episode” with some context of what you’re listening to.  

It’s a beautiful looking and highly functional app that’s just undergone a refit for its 10th birthday by the same developer that created it - to ensure we’ll have it around for another 10 years. This also means that the developer is able to be more flexible going forward - and he’s already added a new feature to “undo” long seeks (where you accidentally fast forward or rewind in your lock screen (outside the app) and suddenly “get lost” in your episode). 

Highly recommended for anyone who loves podcasts.

title.label: Latest update pointlessly messed with a great app

content.label:
Overcast was my favourite podcast app - it did everything I wanted quickly and efficiently and with minimal fuss. Recently, though, it had a big update which was, in my opinion, largely pointless. It moved things around and fiddled with icons and such to largely minimal effect.

If it had just been a new coat of paint I wouldn’t have minded, but the reason I’m giving it a one star review here is it removed a button I used constantly - ‘play next’. When I’m listening to a podcast that I like to queue up the next thing to listen to before it ends. There was a button that let me do that easily with no hassle, but for some incomprehensible reason this has now been removed - I can only add a podcast to the ‘Queue’ (some completely separate thing to whatever automatic play order the app defaults to and which I never use) or a playlist (another feature I never use and have no desire to use).

An incredible instance of a developer of a great, apropos nothing, deciding to shoot themselves in the foot. If ‘play next’ isn’t added back soon I’ll just jump ship to something else, which is a shame because up until now I really liked this app.

title.label: The new update ruined the app

content.label:
The new update has ruined a wonderful app. I’ve used Overcast for nine years — it used to be the best podcast app by a country mile.

This new update has somehow made every aspect of it worse:
Playlists have been moved to the top row, which makes them difficult to select.
The dev completely removed the ability to stream podcasts.
Almost every interaction now requires multiple more taps, like changing settings, or activating the sleep timer.
You can no longer set a custom sleep timer.
The search function is less useful.
The skip forward/backwards buttons have been removed from the Home Screen (requiring another additional tap).
Some downloads just don’t work.
Some episodes need to be downloaded twice??
The dev has removed the ability to delete multiple episodes at once, requiring the laborious process of doing every single one individually.

It’s a disaster. And such a shame. For the first time in almost a decade, I’m looking for another podcast app. Do not recommend.
